name: FUN_BAL_INTRA_RULES_
description: The intracompany balancing rules table contains information about ledger balancing options including the accounts used when only balancing segments two and three are out of balance and clearing company options.

columns.name: INTRA_RULE_ID
columns.description: Ledger balancing options rule identifier.

columns.name: STRUCTURE_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts structure identifier.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier of the ledger balancing option rule.

columns.description: Legal entity identifier of the ledger balancing option rule.

columns.description: Journal category name of the ledger balancing option rule.

columns.name: CLEARING_OPTION
columns.description: Clearing company balancing option for a ledger.

columns.name: CLEARING_BSV
columns.description: Clearing company segment value for balancing.

columns.name: BALANCE_BY_FLAG
columns.description: Option to summarize lines before balancing or balance in detail.

columns.name: MANY_TO_MANY_OPTION
columns.description: Option for the ledger when handling balancing where there are many debits and many credits involving many legal entities.

columns.name: INTRA_RECEIVABLE_CCID
columns.description: Account combination identifier for the receivables account used for ledger balancing.

columns.name: INTRA_PAYABLE_CCID
columns.description: Account combination identifier for the payables account used for ledger balancing.

columns.name: PRECEDENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Order of precedence for evaluating rules to be used for balancing.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the ledger option balancing rule is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date after which the ledger option balancing rule is inactive.
